newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal sees 1997 privatisations for 450 bln esc.
newsitem.headline: Portugal sees 1997 privatisations for 450 bln esc.

text.p: The Portuguese government expects to earn 450 billion escudos from privatisations in 1997, Finance Minister Antonio Sousa Franco said.
The government had initially expected around 380 billion from the sale of state assets in 1996 but it has recently said that the figure could be closer to 450 billion.
State electricity concern EDP is amongst companies the government will privatise or partially privatise next year, according to an already issued programme.
Revenues in 1996 have been swollen by higher than first expected prices earned in the flotation of shares in Portugal Telecom and Banco Portugues de Investimento.
